top_signals.title: Charles Elson on Nvidia’s Corporate Governance Structure
top_signals.summary: Charles Elson, founding director of the University of Delaware’s Weinberg Center for Corporate Governance, says Nvidia’s board should have had a clearer succession plan and stronger oversight in place. He speaks with Romaine Bostick and Jess Menton on “The Close.” (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: China Internet Stock Gains Face Reality Check in Nvidia Fallout
top_signals.summary: A November rebound in beaten-down Chinese internet stocks is facing a reckoning in collateral damage from the scandal at Nvidia Corp.

top_signals.title: Who Runs the Ransomware Group Qilin?
top_signals.summary: The cybercrime group Qilin has emerged as the world's most active ransomware affiliate program, claiming at least 365 victim organizations in the past three months alone. But even top Russian hackers make operational security mistakes, and the administrator of Qilin has made a few key missteps over the last decade that all point to a 36-year-old man living in St. Petersburg, Russia.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Trading Firm IMC Plans to Double Staff in Hong Kong
top_signals.summary: IMC Trading expects to roughly double headcount in its Hong Kong office over the next two years, the latest sign of a rush among foreign firms to expand in the city.
